title: Damage Multiplier
description: DamageMultiplier is a plugin that randomly multiplies player damage.
body:
# [Discord](https://discord.gg/Xw86rqWWcW)

**As the name suggests, DamageMultiplier adds a damage multiplier to Minecraft.**

**This plugin is well suited for challenges as it can make the game a bit more difficult.**

### How it works:

Whenever a player takes damage, it is multiplied by:

```
0; 1; 2; 3
```

In the future, it should be possible to set the multipliers yourself—for example, using commands or in the config.yml.

**If you have any ideas, improvements or feedback, feel free to tell us about them on our Discord server.**
